summary: Typed capture report used Task.run_id without TaskRun.task_id binding, attributing another Task's execution/accounting to the reported Task.
evidence: Reproduced original restricted PostgreSQL FAIL 6d76a7fdfaa61d5fb2a96ed0d50574d54e24b37cfd86ea3c1fb2f78a16e143e0; two synthetic same-owner tasks, actual normal HTTP report accepted mismatched run pointer.
Independent source reviewer identified missing TaskRun.task_id predicate; legacy operations report already applies it.
rollback: Scoped revert with typed feature defaultOFF; preserve all Task/Run/history and original failing witness.
